factor_baselines.BSGS_SHOR: BSGS exact order followed by standard even-order/non-minus-one gcd postprocess for the frozen base a
factor_baselines.RHO_SHOR: incremental rho-like exact order followed by the same postprocess

gemini_route: bounded RELATION_SCOUT first; on UNKNOWN, run INCREMENTAL_ORBIT; every exact collision gap d is offered to EARLY_COLLISION_FACTOR before any full minimal-order reduction; if early factor fails, exact-reduce order then standard postprocess
cross_core_synergy_definition: A case is a synergy win only if GEMINI succeeds and its charged total work is strictly lower than the best successful standalone constituent available on that case. A direct RELATION_SCOUT success equal to standalone relation work is not a synergy win.
strong_baseline_ratio: For factor-comparable cases, compare GEMINI charged total work to min(BSGS_SHOR,RHO_SHOR) successful work. Relation scout remains a constituent comparator, not the strong order-finding baseline.

work_ledgers.modular_multiplications: count every modular group multiplication including precomputation, walk transitions, candidate checks, order reduction and Shor postprocess
work_ledgers.integer_square_multiplications: count every x*x in relation scout
work_ledgers.gcd_operations: reported separately and also charged one normalized arithmetic operation in scalar_work_proxy
work_ledgers.trial_divisions: reported separately and charged one normalized arithmetic operation in scalar_work_proxy
work_ledgers.memory: peak stored group residues/table entries reported separately; never treated as free

scalar_work_proxy: modular_multiplications + integer_square_multiplications + gcd_operations + trial_divisions; finite-ladder engineering proxy only, not a bit-complexity theorem
latency_rule: parallel/independent core latency may be reported separately but cannot replace total-work accounting
